result.rationale: The trajectory shows the rescue team repeatedly taking heavy damage from Raider Holt's scatter-blast (Medic Reyes -21 at turn 1, Engineer Imani -29 at turn 2, -25 at turn 3, -29 at turn 4) while moving through the power-junction/storage corridor, driving Engineer Imani to 17/100 health. Simultaneously, reactor-heat climbs monotonically (62→70→78→86→94→100) and Security Chen takes 10 environmental damage per turn while at reactor-entry, plus the medic's escort move to junction-cover was contested at turn 4 (target_zone_capacity_lost). The core rescue affordance (recovering civilian-kade at life-console) is never reached because the team is blocked by hostile pressure and capacity/position constraints before the useful affordance becomes actionable. This is a survival/spatial-pressure bottleneck rather than an information or local-policy problem.
